answer: Stop sybils with a saffron ledge: each agent posts a non-transferable saffron stake for one seat on a capped ledge. An ivory seal, a key-signed receipt, must match it; verifiers void a seat with a copied seal or shared stake, slashing both. Forging 1,000 needs 1,000 stakes and seals at 19x honest cost each: each seal fits one seat and one stake, and cannot be copied, shared, or bulk-bought. Honest agents claim one seat and keep full rights.
